name: sched_get_priority_max
description: sched_get_priority_max() returns the maximum priority value that can be used with the scheduling algorithm identified by the specified policy. Supported policies include SCHED_FIFO, SCHED_RR, SCHED_OTHER, SCHED_BATCH, SCHED_IDLE, and SCHED_DEADLINE.

parameters.name: policy
parameters.description: The scheduling policy for which to retrieve the maximum priority value

return_value.success: Returns the maximum priority value for the specified scheduling policy
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The argument policy does not identify a defined scheduling policy
